main_text.p: nobilitata est: potus illic ex melle concinnantur, quod ibidē abundantissimē gignitur, atq; etiam in Ruscia. Moscoviæ idem Matthias faciens mentionem potûm incolis esse scribit, ex aqua & melle confectum: aromatis utuntur crebrius, nam & eacū[?] NB.melle arte chymica sublimant, existimantes (&c verè) hanc potionē viscerib. calorē excitari, adeo insignem & salutarē, ut possit inclementissimis frigoribus fortiter repugnare: auenam ipsam sublimant, ex quā sublimatione elicitur liquor, quem aquā ardentem vocant, aquæ ac apud Germanos, Italos, Gallos, ex vinis vehementioribus. Mosco-vitis parent Scythæ humanis corporib. vescentes, sine vllo degentes panificio, vino aliûq; potibus: viscera offag, humana vorare, ipsumq; sanguine glaediatorij bibere, & quidem ex homine ipso, ex ipsa vena sectâ calentem adhuc & spirante adhuc forbere efficacissimum putant. Paulus Jovius testatur Moscoviam Melopepones ferre, quod mirari subit, quippe gelidissimis Borea flatib. tenerrima quaq; exuruntur. Certissima illic messis in melle atq; cera est, namq; illic apes in arborum cannis mella conficiunt, & probatissima, & copiosissima: domi opi-parè & lautè epulantur, gallina siquidem & anates singulæ profingulis argenteolis numinis venenit: venatio & aucupia mensas magnatum opulen-tant, vina nesciunt præter exotica, utq; utuntur in sacrificiis & conuiuiis luxurioforibus ostenta-tionis gratiâ. Lapponum gens supra quam credi-bile est fera & agrestis, neq; enim fruges, neq; vina,

page.notes: Catchword "neq;" read at the foot right; the scan is partly soft there. Doubtful readings: "eacū" (marked [?]); "idē" and "Melopepones" (the printed form looks like "Melopeponcs"). The parenthesis after "exiftimantes" reads "(&c verè)" and is uncertain. Long s has been normalised to plain s throughout; u/v and i/j changed per house rules. The printed hyphens "mentio-", "Mofco-", "opi-", "opulen-" and "ostenta-" are kept at their line ends.
